_comment: Locked capture configuration. Intrinsics MUST be calibrated in this exact mode (same resolution + lens + orientation). fps does not affect intrinsics; resolution and lens do. Decided 2026-08-13.
orientation: landscape - identical for calibration and capture
rationale: 1080p120 chosen over 4K60/1080p240: short exposure keeps fast foot markers sharp (motion blur is the real 2D error source); 120fps richly samples the clearance trajectory (min clearance is a velocity-zero turning point, so fps matters less than intuition); sub-pixel marker centroids make 4K's extra pixels largely redundant if framed tightly.
framing_note: Frame TIGHTLY on the ~1.5 m crossing zone (not the whole walkway) to maximise pixels-per-marker at 1080p. Use ~15-20 mm markers so they span >=15 px.
